title: Use the dialog-selected time for the initial logDose call
description: This is the first of two identical lines in the file (the other is in the too-soon-confirmed retry, task-019) -- occurrence 1 is this one, inside the onSubmit callback's logDose call, since it appears first in the file. Now that AddDoseDialog lets the user pick a time (task-011), this call should use that instead of always capturing 'now'.
